name: AI Issue and Comment Moderator
description: Scan new issues and comments with GitHub Models AI prompts; label or hide spam automatically.

token.description: GitHub token with `issues`, `pull-requests`, and `models: read` permissions

spam-label.description: Label to add when generic spam is detected

ai-label.description: Label to add when AI-generated content is detected

minimize-detected-comments.description: Whether to minimize comments detected as spam

dry-run.description: If true, only evaluate without adding labels or minimizing comments

custom-prompt-path.description: Path to a custom YAML prompt file in your repository (relative to repository root)

enable-link-spam-detection.description: Enable built-in link spam detection prompt

enable-ai-detection.description: Enable built-in AI-generated content detection prompt

endpoint.description: The endpoint to use for inference
